title: Before the hole: the invisible tug-of-war
purpose: More ambitious narrative prototype, not a clinical animation or operative guide

shots.name: The hook
shots.visual: Dimensional hero molar, orbiting sugar and bacteria; camera pushes toward enamel
shots.caption: It starts before the hole.

shots.name: The acid factory
shots.visual: Macro enamel terrain; sugar cubes arrive; some plaque bacteria produce moving acid particles; mineral bricks separate
shots.caption: Plaque + sugars → acid

shots.name: The tug-of-war
shots.visual: Split-screen loss and repair; enamel mineral tile mosaic; saliva droplets and fluoride shield counter orange acid particles
shots.caption: Loss is not the whole story.

shots.name: The threshold
shots.visual: A macro tooth cross-section reveals the surface-breakdown threshold, with a bounded cavity and direct enamel, dentin and pulp labels.
shots.caption: A hole changes the story.

shots.name: The clinical decision
shots.visual: Mirror enters; three assessment cards; conditional restoration sequence; pulp remains intact and distinct
shots.caption: Assess first. Choose treatment.

shots.name: The long game
shots.visual: Brush sweep; fluoride toothpaste, floss and calendar props orbit restored tooth; concluding prevention checklist
shots.caption: The repair is not the finish line.

limits: Schematic anatomy, particles, materials, pace and sequence; not a patient-specific treatment plan, validated tissue simulation or procedure guide. No numeric pH or force claims. Restoration is conditional and abbreviated.
